capabilities.title: Layered permission decision (deny/ask/allow) with rule matching
capabilities.testResult: 2026-11-17: all 22 migrations applied to isolated pgvector PG16; Gateway 49 suites / 303 tests, E2E 2 suites / 24 tests, CLI 28 files / 176 tests passed, zero skipped; CLI/Gateway tsc, Prisma validate, diff check passed. Real Bash parser AST replaces whitespace/operator heuristics. Only literal single-command safe forms are auto-read-only; expansions/redirects/compound syntax and traversal fail closed. Duplicate rule IDs are unique across layers and suffix-like literal pattern collisions. 2026-11-21: Gateway Jest resolves the CLI permission and session-grant subpaths through the shared core package. Permission parity and tool runtime targeted regression passed (2 suites / 16 tests). 2026-11-22: Ocean Core v2 PR #17 quality workflow 44938703238 passed (typecheck, unit, HTTP E2E, fault recovery, isolated PostgreSQL). Shared runtime adapters are additive; existing CLI/Gateway primary Agent Loops are not yet unified, so status remains partial.
gaps: Complex Bash ASTs/expansions remain conservatively non-read-only rather than fully semantically classified.
Lexical path classification does not replace runtime workspace/symlink validation.
Generated duplicate IDs are stable for a given policy ordering, not permanent editor UUIDs.
capabilities.notes: Permission decisions now expose stable reason/source/rule metadata, exact session grants and file-content policy versions. Approvals pin that version; a changed settings file supersedes an approved call and requests a fresh decision. 2026-11-22 PR #18: CLI print, readline, Ink and default one-shot dispatch portable AgentExecutionEngine. Gateway queued Worker uses shared AgentRuntime lifecycle in fenced Prisma transactions. Full model/tool proposal batches, restored restrictive Skill scopes and journal-backed CLI recovery added. Evidence pending latest PR #18 CI; legacy Gateway queue orchestration remains host-owned. No equivalent promotion without final verified CI and mainline parity.

capabilities.title: Approval bound to tool call input, identity, policy and expiry
capabilities.testResult: 2026-11-16: CLI approval create/lookup pin fresh local policyVersion; policy changes during polling reject execution. Gateway stores the fingerprint and only reuses exact-version external grants. Real HTTP/PostgreSQL acceptance covers version mismatch and cleanup. ApprovalMaintenanceService expires approved session grants every minute and removes expired/superseded rows after configured retention. Full isolated acceptance: Gateway 47 suites / 299 tests, E2E 23, CLI 174; zero skipped. CLI/Gateway typechecks, 21 migrations, Prisma validate, diff check passed. Final targeted checks: 24 Gateway approval tests and 17 CLI binding/journal tests passed. 2026-11-21: Isolated PostgreSQL 14 with pgvector 0.8.2 applied all 32 migrations, including approval binding and tool idempotency. The three explicitly enabled PostgreSQL suites (ownership, tool idempotency, device RPC) passed all 7 tests.
capabilities.notes: Approvals now bind tool+args digest, policy version/rule and optional session scope. A policy change supersedes the old approval and requests a fresh one; session approvals cover only the same session/tool/args and expire with the approval TTL. CLI and Web both offer/session-consume the grant path.

capabilities.title: Single execution owner per Run with lease fencing
capabilities.testResult: 2026-11-16: isolated pgvector PG16 full acceptance passed: all 21 migrations applied; Gateway 44 suites / 289 tests, E2E 2 suites / 18 tests, CLI 28 files / 170 tests; zero skipped. CLI/Gateway typechecks, Prisma validate and diff check passed. Two independent Worker processes compete for the same non-idempotent tool; after the owner is SIGKILLed following a filesystem side effect, the survivor acquires the expired lease and marks the original step unknown without replaying the effect. 2026-11-16: actual PG transaction pg_sleep fault injection reproduced stale NOW() lease acceptance; lease comparisons now use clock_timestamp(). Delayed verification after expiry rejects and transaction does not mutate Run. PG-enabled regression passed. 2026-11-21: Isolated PostgreSQL 14 with pgvector 0.8.2 applied all 32 migrations, including approval binding and tool idempotency. The three explicitly enabled PostgreSQL suites (ownership, tool idempotency, device RPC) passed all 7 tests.
capabilities.notes: Both RunRunner and ToolExecutor now use claimRun/verifyRun fencing. Stale recovery clears executionToken/executionJobId/executionAttempt before requeueing, and a competing executor acks without executing.

capabilities.title: Automatic context compaction before every model request in a turn
capabilities.testResult: 2026-11-16: apps/cli vitest 28 files / 160 tests passed; tsc --noEmit passed. Mid-turn trigger, balanced tool-step boundary, durable snapshot, usage accounting and failure/cancellation paths are covered.
capabilities.scope: Before each model step after the first, Ocean re-checks the context budget and compacts at a closed tool-call/tool-result boundary. The durable snapshot is computed over the reconstructed full transcript, so the next turn reuses it. Token estimation precision is tracked separately under CAP-CONTEXT-TOKEN-ACCOUNTING; no compaction boundary UI event is emitted.

capabilities.title: MCP connections and credentials isolated per logical user/workspace
capabilities.testResult: 2026-11-16: pre-registered MCP OAuth implemented: authenticated authorization and disconnect; public callback bound to encrypted one-time state, PKCE S256, ten-minute TTL, provider configuration and persistent revocation epoch. AES-256-GCM per-principal/server records with AAD, private permissions, atomic writes/fsync. Cross-instance rotating refresh serialized with exclusive directory locks. HTTP/SSE transports resolve principal tokens on each request and reject cross-origin/resource mismatch/redirects without replaying tool requests. Real local OAuth/token server covers PKCE, callback replay, expired/config-changed state, tenant isolation, wrong key, restart, refresh deduplication/rotation and disconnect invalidating pending callbacks. Authenticated HTTP E2E covers public callback and identity spoof rejection. Full isolated acceptance passed: all 21 migrations; Gateway 46 suites / 297 tests, E2E 21, CLI 170; zero skipped; CLI/Gateway tsc, Prisma validate and diff check passed.
gaps: OAuth providers require administrator-preconfigured endpoints and registered client IDs; RFC metadata discovery/dynamic client registration are not implemented.
Provider-side token revocation is not implemented; disconnect deletes local tokens and revokes pending local callbacks.
A process killed during a refresh leaves a fail-closed lock requiring operator verification/removal; refresh outcome reconciliation is not implemented.
No external live-provider OAuth acceptance; real network contracts use an isolated local OAuth endpoint.
capabilities.notes: Each logical user/workspace owns a separate MCPClientManager, per-user config home, env overlay, tool cache and lifecycle. Config priority is built-in < user < project < workspace-local; tool names align with the permission namespace. Environment refresh is lazy at the next tool-discovery request; no idle filesystem watcher is claimed. OAuth API and encryption-key/provider configuration are documented in migration/capabilities/mcp-oauth.md. New provisioning and OAuth flows do not return token/secret values through public APIs.
